reason: The hypothesis directly restates the finding from P5 that Hf addition suppresses Cr-V precipitation in a W-Ta-Cr-V alloy, and proposes the same intervention on a very similar composition (W38Ta36Cr15V11 vs. W31Ta34Cr5V27Hf3) with only a modest Hf concentration adjustment. The mechanism (SRO modification leading to homogenization) is taken word for word from P5 and P9, and the predicted outcome mirrors the reported results. The addition of a bulk fabrication goal is a minor extension without a new mechanistic link.
